summary: Iteration 32 — validated (1) new inline application-edit feature in Admin > Users > candidate profile dialog, and (2) backend security hardening (file XSS defense, CV allowlist, RGPD purge). Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass (test_iter32_security.py) covering admin auth matrix (401/403), PUT /applications/{id}/status transitions + invalid rejection, PUT /review persistence, PUT /interview-note guard (only when status=interview_done), public file inline + nosniff, private file 401 no-token / 403 non-owner / 200 owner+admin with nosniff+inline for PDF, DELETE /account RGPD purge, DELETE /users/{id} admin purge of application data, CV upload rejects .txt & .html with 400 and accepts a valid PDF. Frontend: Playwright end-to-end on candidate profile dialog — Edit button opens edit-app-form-{id}; status select exposes exactly the 5 required values; rating select 0..5; interview-note textarea only appears when status=interview_done and hides again when status is changed away; Save persists status/rating/admin_note/interview_note via the 3 documented PUTs and reloads profile so the badge (Entretien fait / 5/5), Internal note and Interview note become visible on the card; Cancel closes the panel without persisting.

minor.issue: Self-delete returns HTTP 400 'Vous ne pouvez pas supprimer votre propre compte' but a super-admin trying to delete themselves via /users/{id} still returns 400 (fine); however DELETE /candidates/{id} on a non-candidate user silently returns 200 without matching any doc — consider returning 404 when no doc deleted.

issues: Section header still reads 'Candidatures (1)' in English mode — the count breaks the FR->EN dictionary exact match (already flagged iter31, unchanged).
StatusBadge for interview statuses renders French ('Entretien fait', 'Entretien fixé') even when UI language = EN. Bind the label to i18n or extend uiDict.js.
Rating dropdown option labels use star + 'Aucune' (French) — should be 'None / 1 ★ / 2 ★ ...' when EN.

Toast messages inside CandidateProfileDialog.saveEdit are hardcoded French ('Candidature mise à jour', 'Échec de la mise à jour') — sonner toasts bypass the DOM-scan translator. Use t()/useTranslation.

openEdit initialises eStatus from the persisted status so the interview-note textarea auto-shows for apps already in interview_done state — good UX, but 'Note d'entretien' label + placeholder ('Compte-rendu de l\'entretien...') remain in French in EN mode.
Section labels inside edit form ('Statut', 'Appréciation', 'Note interne', 'Note d\'entretien', 'Enregistrer', 'Annuler') are hardcoded French.
fmtDate still hardcodes fr-FR ('Postulé le 1 septembre 2026') — carried over from iter31.

action_items: i18n polish only: translate CandidateProfileDialog edit-form labels, toasts, StatusBadge tokens (Entretien fixé/fait), rating 'Aucune', and 'Candidatures (n)' via t() instead of DOM scan; format dates using i18n.language.
critical_code_review_comments: CandidateProfileDialog.saveEdit fires up to 3 PUTs sequentially without transactional guarantees; if the /interview-note call fails after /status has already flipped to interview_done, the DB ends up in a partial state. Consider a single admin endpoint that accepts (status, rating, admin_note, interview_note) atomically.

The /applications/{id}/interview-note endpoint hard-rejects (400) when status!=interview_done, but the frontend guards this by calling it only when eStatus==='interview_done' — save() sends status BEFORE the interview-note PUT which is correct; however if only the interview-note changed (status already interview_done) the code still works, good. Doc-comment the ordering.

applications.py::review_application silently ignores rating=None but does not allow clearing an existing rating back to null (uses $set only when body.rating is not None). If a recruiter wants to clear a rating, they cannot — consider explicit unset when rating is null.

purge_user_data does NOT delete db.jobs authored by the user (n/a for candidates) nor db.calls / db.recordings / db.conversations — audit RGPD coverage against all collections; today it covers applications/messages/cv_data/files/interviews/contracts/notifications/user_sessions.

core._safe_file_response falls back to _INLINE_SAFE by lowered content-type without also whitelisting the extension — a stored record with content_type='image/svg+xml' would be treated as unsafe (good) but 'image/PNG ' (with trailing space) would still be safe because of .strip(). Fine, just noting.

auth.py::upload_profile_cv extension check is bypassable: if content_type is in allowlist even a .exe filename passes; hardening: require BOTH extension AND content_type to be in allowlist, or sniff the magic bytes.

rca of the issue: No functional bug found. All iter32 acceptance criteria met. Remaining items are cosmetic i18n gaps and low-risk code-review suggestions (atomic save, RGPD collection audit, magic-byte sniffing for CV upload).
